programs.name: Hometown Heroes Program

amount.text: up to 5% of the first mortgage amount, maximum $35,000, minimum $10,000

programs.repayment: 0% non-amortizing 30-year deferred second mortgage, not forgivable; due on sale, refinance, transfer or end of term
programs.firstTimeNote: full-time workers of a Florida-based employer in listed occupations (health care, school staff, first responders, public safety, court, child care…)
programs.status: 2025-2026 funds fully reserved (all $63 million as of April 17, 2026); 2026-2027 timeline not published

programs.name: Florida Assist (FL Assist)

amount.text: up to $10,000 on FHA, VA, USDA and Conventional loans

programs.repayment: 0% deferred second mortgage, not forgivable, repayable on sale, refinance, transfer or satisfaction of the first mortgage

programs.name: HFA Preferred PLUS / HFA Advantage PLUS second mortgage

amount.text: 3%, 4% or 5% of the first mortgage loan amount

programs.repayment: forgiven at 20% a year over a 5-year term, with Florida Housing conventional HFA Preferred or HFA Advantage first mortgages
